title: Subsequence Path
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 2 \leq N \leq 2 \times 10^5; 1 \leq M, K \leq 2 \times 10^5; 1 \leq A_i, B_i \leq N, A_i \neq B_i \, (1 \leq i \leq M); 1 \leq C_i \leq 10^9 \, (1 \leq i \leq M); 1 \leq E_i \leq M \, (1 \leq i \leq K); All values in the input are integers.
